title: Zesty Yeasty Spanish Chicken Paella
description: A yeasty and velvety Spanish dish featuring fennel seeds and shio-cure, perfect for a post-workout meal. This Whole30-friendly recipe is made with wholesome ingredients and is easy to prepare.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the fennel seeds, shio-cure, smoked paprika, sea salt, and black pepper.
Add the cauliflower rice to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with a side of roasted vegetables, if desired.
